title: Holy Grail
start: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot.

recommended.t: Tokkul-Zo, for quick access to the Fairy ring network
Activated Draynor, Karamja, and Port Sarim lodestones

rewards.t: Access to the Fisher Realm (code BJR)
Ability to use the King Arthur picture in your player-owned house

steps.t: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot Castle. [Chat: 1 Tell me of this quest. › Accept]
Go to the floor 2 using the staircase and talk to Merlin. [Chat: 2 Where can I find Sir Galahad?]
Go to Entrana by talking to a Monk of Entrana. You will be asked to bank armour and weapons, which can also be done at the bank deposit box at the docks.
Speak to the high priest, who is in the main chapel of the church. [Chat: 1 What can you tell me about this place?]
Speak to the crone who appears. [Chat: 4 I will go searching.]
Head to Seers' Village lodestone.
Talk to Galahad, located in a building west of McGrubor's Wood and east of the coal trucks. [Chat: 2 I'm on a quest to find the Holy Grail! › 3 Why did you leave?]

sub.t: You must speak to the crone on Entrana first, or he will not give you the holy table napkin.

steps.t: Take the holy table napkin to the southern room of the top-most floor of Draynor Manor. The way to the topmost floor is by climbing the main staircase and using the ladder on the southern wall.
p: The holy grail on the table

steps.t: Pick up the two magic whistles on the table.
Go to Brimhaven and blow the whistle under the wooden watchtower (refer to the map on the right).
Go north-west and defeat Black Knight Titan with Excalibur. Low levels may find it useful to safespot the Black Knight Titan with Magic, Ranged, or Necromancy and last hit him with Excalibur.
Head south along the river and talk to the fisherman by the river. [Chat: 2 Any idea how to get into the castle?]
Be sure to keep the magic whistle in your inventory from this point forward.
Go south-west, to the castle. Take the grail bell on the ground outside the castle and ring it.
Head upstairs using the south staircase and talk to the Fisher King. [Chat: 3 You don't look too well.]
Talk to King Arthur in Camelot Castle. Make sure you have space to receive the magic gold feather.
Teleport to the Falador lodestone.
Head north to the Goblin Village, go into the eastern house, and right-click to open the sacks to find Sir Percival. [Chat: 3 Your father wishes to speak to you.]
Return to the Fisher King's castle in his realm by blowing your whistle north west of Brimhaven (or by using Fairy ring BJR).
Go up the staircase on the east side of the castle, climb to the top floor and grab the Holy grail.
Go back to King Arthur.
Quest complete!
